description: Presidential Secretariat - Sri Lanka Ports Authority, Supply and distribution of all Fuels, Sri Lanka Railway Transport Board etc. as an Essential Public Services
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory declaration by the President under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It establishes a regulatory framework by declaring specific services as essential services for the operation of the Act, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on creating legal obligations and compliance requirements for various public service providers.
